transcript: My 15,000 rupee TV now runs like a 1 lakh TV. The crazy part? I did it all in just 15 minutes, absolutely for free. All you have to do is grab your remote, go to settings, then system, then about, and click on Android TV OS build seven times. That unlocks developer mode. Then open developer options and turn on USB debugging. Now pick up your laptop, connect it to the same Wi-Fi, open Claude Code, copy this full prompt, and press enter. Notice that it never says the word "hack," because if you just type "hack my TV," the AI might refuse. Claude will find your TV on your Wi-Fi by itself and start the process. First, it sorts every app on your TV into groups, like ad services, tracking apps, and the factory apps you never open. And it asks you which ones to switch off. Then it turns them off one batch at a time, along with the background processes that slow your TV down. Nothing gets deleted, and it saves a restore file, so you can undo everything later. Just like that, you've got a clean home screen without a single ad. One developer took his home screen from using 192 MB of memory down to just 83, and another got about 90% more free memory on his parents' old TV. Another cool thing is that with just a prompt, you can change the entire look of your home screen. People have added rotating wallpapers, a screen saver that shows their live sales, and even a 3D model of their apartment with lights that switch on in real time. This works on Android and Google TVs, and you can customize your TV literally according to you. Share this with someone whose TV is painfully slow. And if you want to learn how to use Claude like this for everything, I am doing a free workshop. Click the link in description below and grab the limited time offer now.
